trigger.deployment_evidence: The current official Polymarket event page exposed the active Ethereum September 4 threshold ladder before freeze. Discovery prices are excluded from every decision.

question: Does the exact current Ethereum September 4 threshold ladder contain any rejection-only Gamma displayed package where YES at a lower threshold plus NO at a higher threshold costs strictly less than its exact one-pUSD payout floor?
required_rule_fragments: final "Close" price higher than the price specified in the title
not according to other exchanges or trading pairs

payoff_identity.package: buy one YES share at threshold L and one NO share at threshold H where L is strictly less than H

decision.source_gate: Require the exact slug, title, eleven thresholds, active accepting binary markets, common exact resolution fragments, token identities, and valid displayed prices.
decision.rejection_only_gate: Rank all 55 lower-YES plus higher-NO packages and stop before books unless at least one displayed sum is strictly below 1 pUSD.
decision.book_gate_if_triggered: A displayed candidate authorizes only a separately frozen exact two-token batch with contract-bound exact fee schedule, minimum size, tick, freshness, one-adverse-tick stress, and complete costs. Gamma can never accept or promote the edge.

retry_policy: This exact event GET is one-use. Preserve any response, mismatch, partial population, or calculation failure and do not retry the event, an alias, another threshold subset, or a favorable sibling merely to obtain a candidate. Reopen the family only for a distinct active BTC ETH or SOL ladder outside every consumed event with complete exact rules and at least one rejection-only displayed package strictly below its payout floor, or a material fee, rule, delay, or execution change.
